timing.resolution: Source work counts and variable codepoint scans/concatenation, not fixed whole-call timing or a physical clock/RTC guarantee.

interrupts.resolution: Ordinary BIOS calls use canonical CPU/IRQ and protected-call boundaries; no additional IRQ acknowledgement or wait protocol is introduced.

faults.resolution: Ordered required-field/integer/range/conversion errors and ordinary indexing faults; false is not nil. Independent source/merged-delta checks pass, including exact false-timestamp rejection before bounds; common Table-length dependency remains separately open.

reset.resolution: SYSTEM/CPU/Memory remain counter/startup/reset authorities; civil zero mapping does not establish hardware epoch, timezone, RTC, reset origin or universal persistence.
